'''Gordy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual seen in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], the City of Masks, in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. Like all the visitors and many inhabitants, this person was in disguise; particularly Gordy was disguised as [[Kilassin]] grass. While dancing, Gordy sometimes moved his head back and growled, simulating a [[Cularin lizard]] in action.
